# Patternode for developers

> Patternode keeps none of your series: a forming series travels as a sealed edge you store and send back with the next bars. The API contracts, examples and guides for integrating with Patternode's products: Delve (the shards toolkit, formerly Mosaic) now, and Essence, Sentinel and Foresight, which run on Delve. Build and test against the mock (`python mock/mock_patternode.py`) first. The specs in `specs/` are the contract. Never put an API key in code, a file, a log or a chat. Real access is requested by a person (`website/docs/get-started/access.md`).

The site is https://developers.patternode.com, with every page as Markdown and its own index at https://developers.patternode.com/llms.txt. Paths below are in this repository.

## Start

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what an agent does, step by step
- [Quickstart](website/docs/get-started/quickstart.mdx): the first calls, against the mock or production
- [Getting access](website/docs/get-started/access.md): the three levels of access and how to ask
- [Getting your API keys](website/docs/get-started/api-keys.md): kinds, scopes, storage, rotation
- [The mock server](website/docs/get-started/mock-server.md): what it checks and what it fakes

## Contracts

- [OpenAPI 3.1](specs/openapi.yaml): every REST operation, with `x-status`
- [AsyncAPI 3.1](specs/asyncapi.yaml): every event, on webhooks, subscriptions and event buses
- [gRPC](specs/proto/patternode/delve/v1/delve.proto): the high-volume transport
- [JSON Schemas](specs/schemas/): bar, sample, segment box, error, event
- [Contract tests](tests/contract/test_contract.py): the contract as tests, for any implementation
